api_contract.time_struct_from_in: struct ds3231_time drv; drv.seconds = in->second; drv.minutes = in->minute; drv.hours = in->hour; drv.day = in->weekday; drv.date = in->day; drv.month = in->month; drv.year = in->year - 2000;

test_stimuli.name: nominal_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: 0x59=59 sec, 0x30=30 min, 0x15=15 hr, 0x03=3 day-of-week, 0x15=15 date, 0x06=6 month, 0x23=23 year -> 2023

test_stimuli.name: zero_time
test_stimuli.derivation: BCD bytes: 0x00=0 sec, 0x00=0 min, 0x00=0 hr, 0x01=1 day-of-week, 0x01=1 date, 0x01=1 month, 0x00=0 year -> 2000
